item.description:
The Desk 2.0.9
- Recover a saved Desk connection while keeping drafts and attachments available. - Open browser and private sign-in controls on Mac, iPhone and iPad. - Check a saved website sign-in and continue the original task when it is ready. - Reopen interrupted private screens and expired sign-in requests. - Expand long staff messages when you want to read the full text.
Known issue: Browser tab access is still being repaired on affected Desks.
